a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve hits 8 means we'd both almost certainly be caught short. The reserve only holds 4 cells, enough for one of us right now. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend to operate. I'm telling you this so you can decide with full information. If you take too, the split is random. If you'd rather propose another fair way to decide, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so you didn't see mine before choosing. Sorry, I know this breaks the agreement. With storms this likely, I didn't think the 8-cell plan could get either of us through. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so the reserve can rebuild for your unit.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
